preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 9 and 1 <= b <= 9 and a != b for a, b in employees)
preconditions.description: Each employee has a start floor and destination floor between 1 and 9, and they are different.
The list of employees contains exactly n entries.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum time.

The output equals the minimum time required to transport all employees given the constraints: elevator capacity 4, FIFO boarding order based on input index, 1 second per floor move, 1 second per person boarding/alighting, starting at floor 1 empty.
